source_title: Deep Google Store discounts on Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5 start early
source_excerpt:
Like other retailers, the US Google Store is already starting Black Friday-level discounts on the Pixel 11 series and Pixel Watch 5 at the end of October.
Google is now taking $200 off the Pixel 11, which is double the last sale in early October . The Pixel 11 Pro is $300 off (versus $200), while it’s $350 off (compared to $250) for the Pixel 11 Pro XL.
Finally, the Pixel 11 Pro Fold sees only a $250 discount. There are matching discounts at Amazon and Best Buy today.
These discounts end on November 8, 2026 at 11:59 PM PST. The Google Store deals are starting pretty early, and it remains to be seen if the actual Black Friday prices will be identical or go slightly further.
